'''Verkuylians''' were the native [[Human/Legends|Human]] population who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Verkuyl]]. Originally indentured workers to [[Verkuylian BactaCo]], the Verkuylians were freed from their servitude when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nationalized the company.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
